close_reason: spec_section_id/spec_url default impls now delegate to the deprecated rfc_section_id/rfc_url aliases (asymmetric delegation — the deprecated aliases stay None-defaulted to avoid infinite recursion). Pre-0.6.0 Lint impls that override only the deprecated methods now produce non-None values through the canonical entry points with zero source changes. Scheduled removal target pinned at pkix-lint 0.10.0. Two regression tests lock both shapes (pre-0.6.0 override + post-0.6.0 override). 295 tests pass; clippy clean. Commit landing.
description:
lib.rs:856-868 + 878-890: rfc_section_id / rfc_url are #[deprecated(since='0.6.0')] default methods that return None. spec_section_id / spec_url were added as the new canonical methods. The rustdoc on rfc_section_id says 'calling the deprecated alias on a lint that overrides only spec_section_id returns None' — i.e. the two are INDEPENDENT default impls, not delegations.

Failure mode: a downstream consumer that built a Lint impl against pkix-lint 0.5.x, where it overrode rfc_section_id, upgrades to 0.6.0. The deprecation warning fires but the override still works locally — until the consumer touches an OSCAL Catalog emitter that calls spec_section_id and gets None, silently dropping the section id from every Control. Worse, a consumer that built against 0.6.0 and overrode spec_section_id finds rfc_section_id still returns None on their impl — anything calling the deprecated alias for backwards compat sees a different shape.

Maintainer consequence: every deprecation cycle that ships independent defaults instead of delegation creates this class of silent-divergence bug. The fix is one-line delegation: rfc_section_id default should be 'self.spec_section_id()' (deprecated but always-correct), and spec_section_id should default-delegate to rfc_section_id for the next minor (so 0.5.x impls keep working). That way overriding either side produces a consistent answer from both, until the deprecated alias is removed in a future minor.

Bonus: the CHANGELOG promises the deprecated aliases will be removed 'no earlier than' some unspecified version. Pin a concrete target version so consumers can plan.
title: Lint::rfc_section_id / rfc_url deprecated default methods leak silent breakage when overridden alone
